2608.24842.title: Reading Is Not Using: Retrieval, Judgment, and the Design of AI Financial Research Workflows
2608.24842.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as AI analysts to process financial disclosures and support AI-assisted investment decisions. Yet such systems are usually evaluated by what they can retrieve, not whether retrieved information affects their judgments. We identify a retrieval-integration gap in long-context financial analysis. Holding focal-firm information fixed and varying only unrelated context from 2,000 to 128,000 tokens, we find that a risk disclosure's influence on investment judgments falls to the experimental noise floor even as direct retrieval remains accurate. The pattern replicates across model families and judgment tasks and in experiments removing real disclosures from actual 10-K filings. More capable models postpone but do not eliminate the gap. Causal memory interventions show that compressed summaries and source-text lookup jointly transmit disclosures into judgments. Workflow architecture determines whether this transmission succeeds: chunk-and-summarize pipelines evict relevant information, whereas a targeted, structured restatement adjacent to the decision restores its influence. AI analyst performance is therefore jointly determined by model capability and workflow architecture. Retrieval-based evaluations can certify systems whose investment judgments ignore information they demonstrably retrieved.
2608.24842.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）越來越多地被用作人工智慧分析師，以處理財務披露並支持人工智慧輔助的投資決策。<lb/>然而，這些系統通常是根據它們能檢索到的內容來評估，而不是檢索到的信息是否影響其判斷。我們在長上下文的財務分析中識別出一個檢索整合差距。<lb/>在固定焦點公司的信息並且僅變化不相關的上下文從 2,000 到 128,000 個標記的情況下，我們發現風險披露對投資判斷的影響降至實驗噪音底線，即使直接檢索仍然準確。<lb/>這種模式在模型家族和判斷任務中重複出現，並且在移除實際 10-K 文件中的真實披露的實驗中也得到了驗證。<lb/>更強大的模型延遲但不消除這一差距。<lb/>因果記憶干預顯示，壓縮摘要和源文本查找共同將披露轉化為判斷。<lb/>工作流程架構決定了這一傳輸是否成功：分塊和摘要管道會排除相關信息，而與決策相鄰的有針對性、結構化的重述則恢復其影響。因此，人工智慧分析師的表現是由模型能力和工作流程架構共同決定的。<lb/>基於檢索的評估可以認證那些投資判斷忽略其明顯檢索到的信息的系統。
